visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt with text, is seen in an indoor home setting. She is facing the camera, smiling, and gesturing with her hands as if speaking. The background includes a doorway, a dresser, and soft indoor lighting from a window. (2) The woman shifts her gaze away from the camera, mimicking a conversation. Her facial expressions are animated, transitioning from a serious order-taking look to a satisfied smile with a slight head tilt. (3) The scene cuts to the woman holding a blue and yellow pen, drawing a circular shape in the air while looking at the camera with a wide, theatrical smile. The lighting remains bright and natural. (4) The camera angle changes to a high-angle shot looking down at a white Shiba Inu dog lying on a light-colored wooden floor next to a blue suitcase and stuffed toys. A person's legs are visible near the dog. (5) Back to a close-up of the woman, she suddenly displays an expression of exaggerated discomfort and cringe, squinting her eyes and twisting her mouth as if reacting to an embarrassing memory. (6) The woman is sitting indoors, looking down at a red-cased smartphone in her hands. Suddenly, she jerks her body upward in a startled reaction, looking towards the camera with a shocked expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks English with a polite, service-oriented tone over a soft acoustic guitar background. The speech is clear with moderate speed. (2) A sudden upbeat, synthesized Disney-style musical jingle triggers. It includes a bright 'sparkle' chime effect and a rhythmic orchestral burst. (3) The music stops, replaced by the same female voice singing in a stylized, exaggerated, high-pitched comedic tone in Chinese, with no background music. (4) A quirky, mid-tempo orchestral piece featuring staccato piano notes begins as the female voice makes sounds of distress and embarrassment. (5) Complete silence for a split second, followed by the loud, sharp rhythmic pulse of a standard digital phone ringtone. The female voice emits a short, high-arousal shriek of surprise before the audio cuts.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Activity Montage -> Startle Hook
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the private, high-energy, and often eccentric behaviors an introverted person (I-person) exhibits when alone, contrasted with their low tolerance for sudden real-world interruptions like a phone call.
